notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.2.0
notes.notes: [h1]Update Notice 0.1.2.0[/h1][p][/p][h2]Monster Adjustments[/h2][p]Hush / Hush: Race changed to Dragon (no longer Beast)[/p][p]Rat King: Rarity changed to Legendary[/p][p]King Slime: Added Entrance Effect (triggers once when synthesized)[/p][p][/p][p]New Monsters Added: Funky Turkey / Golden Turkey[/p][p][/p][h2]Character Adjustments[/h2][p]Increased HP for all characters[/p][p][/p][h2]Mechanic Adjustments[/h2][p]   Added a Shop phase as preparation time before entering Endless Mode, allowing an additional turn to adjust your lineup.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other Changes[/h2][p]Fixed a bug where terrain information could display abnormally when swapping grid positions.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where some monsters could be placed in incorrect load positions.[/p][p]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash on some device models when dragging the mouse selection box to the top-left corner.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where character voice lines could play repeatedly when facing the Barbarian Crusher opponent.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fix Regarding Battle Opponent Data Abnormality and Update Preview
notes.notes: [h1]Issue Regarding Abnormal Battle Opponent Data[/h1][p]We recently received feedback from some players about being matched with abnormal opponents in the game. We immediately investigated and located the issue, which was caused by the expiration of our game server. [/p][p][/p][p]We have now successfully renewed the service and restored its functionality. We deeply apologize for the negative experience this caused![/p][p][/p][h1]Version 0.1.0.0 Update Preview[/h1][p]We will bring you the first content update on July 16th! The game will introduce a brand new race - Machine, 3 new characters, and a large number of new monsters and relics![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Finally, thank you all for your love and support of "Monster Battles"![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.3.0
notes.notes:
## Patch Notes 0.0.3.0  

**Monster Adjustments:**  
- Golden Three-Eyed Frog: Deathrattle-summoned monsters inherit 50% of extra attributes  
- Thornheart:  
  ▶ Now affects 4 allied non-Thornheart monsters  
  ▶ Effect changed from +2 HP to +1 HP  
  ▶ Base stats adjusted to 5/3  
- Thornheart Nira:  
  ▶ Now affects 4 allied non-Thornheart monsters  
  ▶ Effect changed from +2 HP to +1 HP  
  ▶ Base stats adjusted to 15/12  
- Forest Direwolf: Price adjusted to 6 Gold  
- Red-Eye Direwolf: Price adjusted to 12 Gold  
- Blackfeather Motmo: Price adjusted to 7 Gold  
- Motmo: Price adjusted to 14 Gold  
- Sand Dancer: Base stats changed to 3/2  
- Gorgeous Sand Dancer: Base stats changed to 9/6  
- Stone Crab: Base stats changed to 3/5  
- Giant Stone Crab: Base stats changed to 9/15  
- Goblin Engineer: Damage adjusted to 4  
- Senior Engineer: Damage adjusted to 8  
- Rat King: ★ position adjusted  
- Golden Rat King: ★ position adjusted  
- Carrion Vulture: Effect changed to +1/+2  
- Golden Carrion Vulture: Effect changed to +2/+4  
- Deathsinger Hash: Now randomly triggers 1 On-play effect after attacking  
- Hash: Now randomly triggers 2 On-play effects after attacking  
- Gentle Skunk: Effect adjusted to +2 HP  
- Goblin Overseer:  
  ▶ Changed to 1 ★ position  
  ▶ Effect: Grants +8/+8 to ★ position Goblin  
- Warband Overseer:  
  ▶ Changed to 1 ★ position  
  ▶ Effect: Grants +12/+12 to ★ position Goblin  
- Earth Guardian: Now deals damage to all enemies in 3×3 range  
- Brown Drake: Now affects other Dragon-types in same row  
- Amber Drake: Now affects other Dragon-types in same row  

**Battlefield Adjustments:**  
- Serpent Poison Swamp: Now applies 2 stacks of Poison  

**Relic Adjustments:**  
- Bagged Ooze: Changed to one-time effect (free, no Gold cost)  
- Sage's Stone: Now only affects non-locked monsters (right-click locked)  

**Performance Optimization:**  
- Added 5x speed option for battles  

**Bug Fixes:**  
- Fixed shopkeeper display errors on specific device models

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.2.4
notes.notes:
## Patch Notes 0.0.2.4  

**Quality of Life Improvements:**  
- New Hotkeys:  
  ▶ Move all field monsters to For-Sale Area (C)  
  ▶ Move all field monsters/land tiles to For-Sale Area (V)  
  ▶ Sell all items in For-Sale Area (B)  
  ▶ Sell hovered monster in For-Sale Area (G)  
  ▶ Shop Refresh Bell (D)  
  ▶ Rotate/Lock function (T)  

**Other Fixes:**  
- Fixed Dragon Girl's unlock condition mistranslation on character select screen  
  (Correct: Purchase 1 Dragon-type Legendary or higher rarity monster)

notes.notes:
## Patch Notes 0.0.2.2

- Improved battle animations:  
  - Faster skill animations for:  
    (Black Crow, Morena, Harsh, Reaper, and other monsters)  

**Bug Fixes:**

If you continue to experience freezing or crashing issues, please contact our support team. We greatly appreciate your feedback.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.2.1
notes.notes:
## Patch Notes 0.0.2.1

**System Changes:**
- Endless Mode:
  - New options added after completing Round 16:
    * Continue battling Rounds 17-20 against other players (No rank point changes/No same-tier matchmaking/May face players of all ranks)
    * Directly begin Endless Trial
  - Difficulty adjustment: Removed first 4 waves of lower-difficulty enemies, now starts from Wave 5

**Performance Improvements:**
- Optimized animations for monsters with growth-type skills:
  - Reduced skill activation delay
  - Improved animation playback speed

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.1.7
notes.notes:
## Patch Notes 0.0.1.7

**Monster Adjustments:**
- Goblin Warlock: Rarity decreased
- Fel Warlock: Rarity decreased

notes.title: Update Notes 0.0.1.4
notes.notes:
## Update Notes 0.0.1.4  

**Monster Adjustments:**  
- Flame Ooze: Base ATK adjusted to 0.  
- Goblin Blacksmith: Trigger cost adjusted to 6 Gold.  

**Operational Optimization:**  
- Added minimize button during Relic/Monster Selection to view current lineup/shop details.  
- Added Codex access via bottom-right button during Relic/Monster Selection.  

**Other Changes:**  
- Fixed duplication bug when replaying Adventure Mode.  
- Fixed Crimson Ooze effect failure.  
- Fixed egg's chance to yield Epic Flame Ooze when acquiring Mythic monsters.  
- Fixed egg's chance to yield Legendary Porcupine when acquiring Epic monsters.  
- Fixed premature Legendary Porcupine appearance in shops.  
- Fixed performance degradation/crash issues during extended play sessions (if crashes persist, please contact us).
